description: Verifies the relativistic rocket against the closed-form hyperbolic motion of constant proper acceleration in flat spacetime: proper time, velocity, position and Lorentz factor over a grid of accelerations and coordinate times.

checks.label: the proper time matches the hyperbolic solution within 1e-7 over the whole grid
the velocity matches the hyperbolic solution within 1e-7 over the whole grid
the position matches the hyperbolic solution within 1e-6 over the whole grid
the Lorentz factor matches the hyperbolic solution within 1e-7 over the whole grid
